scope: H5 open-arena DCM-control temporal profile only
scientific_role: mechanism-definition decision; not parameter fitting, ranking, or promotion evidence

decision.definition: For a fixed recent_constrained_travel_mm and current geometry, H5's history search drive does not decay as a function of elapsed observed arena time. No tau_search_s parameter exists in H5-v1.
decision.history_dependence_still_allowed: The magnitude may still depend on recent constrained travel L through a separately frozen history parameterization; this decision does not freeze D(L).

measurement_basis.measurement_time_origin: The frozen measurement policy starts simulated observation at first_track_x_mm/first_track_y_mm.
measurement_basis.biological_origin: The H5 biological origin is the central physical entry-hole/trail-crossing reference.
measurement_basis.unobserved_interval: The center-hole-to-first-track interval is not reconstructed and has no elapsed-time field in the frozen geometry reference.
measurement_basis.consequence: Any decay beginning at physical arena entry would require an unobserved pre-track delay delta that is not identified by the current measurement reconstruction.

rejected_alternative.name: exponential_temporal_decay
reason: delta_pretrack, the elapsed time from physical entry to first tracked observation, is not measured or reconstructed.
For exponential decay, delta_pretrack is exactly multiplicatively confounded with drive amplitude through exp(-delta_pretrack/tau_search_s).

The first major reorientation commonly occurs within the same order of time as plausible sub-second-to-second pre-track delays, so the ambiguity affects the first H5-eligible event rather than only a late tail.
Fast-to-moderate tau values are materially sensitive to the unknown delay; very slow tau values approach a constant profile while adding a weakly identified parameter.

diagnostic_sensitivity_not_fit.note: The delay and tau values below were a broad engineering sensitivity grid only, not empirical estimates or candidate search values.

structural_reasoning.exponential_confounding_identity: exp(-(t+delta)/tau) = exp(-delta/tau) * exp(-t/tau), so unknown delta is inseparable from amplitude without independent timing information.
structural_reasoning.parsimony: A constant temporal profile removes tau_search_s and the unobserved time-zero nuisance while preserving the core H5 claim: history modulates origin-referenced reorientation direction.
structural_reasoning.falsifiability: H5-v1 therefore makes a cleaner claim. Any observed within-trial weakening of origin-oriented turning would count against this v1 rather than being absorbed by a fitted temporal decay.
structural_reasoning.independence_from_prior_H2_H3_H4_failure: This decision is based on measurement identifiability and mechanism parsimony, not on selecting whichever temporal profile improves known H5 outcomes.

next_step: Resolve whether H5-v1 changes only conditional reorientation direction or also orientation-dependent free-path length.
